name: Türkçe hata dili ve dürüst durumlar

local_gate.result: PASS except the same live-desktop test B21 recorded
local_gate.web_gates: vitest 1712 passed / 91 files, tsc clean, oxlint 0 errors

the_desktop_test_now_names_its_cause.measured: B21 left this READY_FOR_OWNER with the intruder unnamed. The diagnosis added there has now answered it: "after 3 attempt(s) the click landed while the foreground was Claude [claude.exe]". Sampling the foreground directly confirms it - hwnd 5834690, process `claude`, held continuously while this session works. It is not the owner's video, not a leftover Notepad and not a flake: the agent's own client owns the desktop's foreground while the agent is working, so `window.activate` succeeds and is reverted within milliseconds.
the_desktop_test_now_names_its_cause.consequence: The operator lab's Notepad tests cannot pass from inside this client. They failed 5 of 5 runs while the app was in front, and passed three times earlier the same day. No code in B21 or B22 touches devices/.
the_desktop_test_now_names_its_cause.for_the_owner: Run the gate's device step with the Claude app not in the foreground, or set PAGENTOS_OPERATOR_LAB=0 for that run. CI is unaffected: a runner has no interactive desktop, so `OperatorLab.SkipReason()` skips the lab there.
the_desktop_test_now_names_its_cause.not_done: The assertion was not loosened, the retry count was not raised (each attempt already re-activates and verifies `foreground: true`, and the disturbance is continuous rather than periodic - more attempts would sample the same state), and the lab was not disabled from inside the batch.

what_this_proves: A failure now says, in Turkish, what happened and what can be done about it — and the four kinds of waiting are four different sentences with four different controls. The owner cannot be shown a Python exception by any route, and a route that tried to would fail a test rather than a person.
the_shape_of_this_batch: A vocabulary problem with a structural fix. Eight subsystems declared their own error taxonomies (fifty-six classes) and forty more classes lived as string constants; not one of them said anything in Turkish, and thirty-three route handlers answered a failed request with `HTTPException(detail=str(exc))` — developer English, rendered verbatim by the web. The dictionary is the visible half; the AST guard is the half that keeps it true.

closed_fully.704_one_dictionary_and_it_is_complete: `app.errors.catalog.TR` holds 96 entries, each saying WHAT happened and WHAT CAN BE DONE. `test_every_error_class_has_turkish` reads BOTH sources of truth — the eight Enum families by import, and the `ERROR_* = "..."` constants and inline `"error_class"` literals by scanning the source — and fails in both directions.
closed_fully.705_no_route_can_answer_with_an_exceptio: All 33 sites now build their body with `app.errors.owner_detail`, which puts the exception in the LOG (with the trace id) and a Turkish sentence on the wire. The guard is an AST scan: inside an `except X as exc:` handler, an `HTTPException` whose `detail` mentions `exc` fails — with one exception, `exc.error_class`, because a class token is a closed-taxonomy value the catalogue translates and the news domain's own classes are part of the API contract. The web has a second lock: a body that carries a Python failure is dropped in favour of the fallback sentence, so an old Cloud Core or a proxy error page cannot show a traceback either.
closed_fully.706_707_loading_is_not_empty: The cockpit's `Panel` has distinguished loading / failed / absent / empty since it was built. The pages had not: `/artifacts` held `useState<ArtifactSummary[]>([])`, so before the first answer it rendered the same empty list it would render for an account with no artifacts. It now holds a `Loaded<T>` and renders through the same `LoadedNotice`.
closed_fully.708_a_retry_only_where_a_retry_can_work: `RETRYABLE_CLASSES` is the set of failures that can clear on their own — a timeout, a rate limit, an unreachable dependency. The button is bound to that, not to "this is a failure": a retry control on a missing API key is an invitation to press it forever.
closed_fully.709_710_711_three_kinds_of_waiting: A provider that is not configured, a permission that was never granted, and a decision that is the owner's are three waits, not three errors. Each has its own heading, its own hint about who can act, and no retry. `owner_action` deliberately never prints the word "Alınamadı": nothing failed.

found_on_the_way.the_completeness_test_that_read_only_hal: The first version of `test_every_error_class_has_turkish` imported the eight Enum families — the same eight the catalogue was written from. It passed, and the dictionary was missing forty classes that live as module constants (`news`, `research`, `artifacts`, the device action path, the operator). It surfaced only because a route rewrite replaced `identity_unresolved` with a generic class and a news test that pinned the token by name went red. Both halves of an assertion from one source cannot fail; the test now scans the source as well.
found_on_the_way.the_class_token_is_part_of_the_contract: That same news test is the reason `owner_detail(exc.error_class)` exists: callers match on the class, so a rewrite that 'tidied' it into `constraint_violation` broke a contract. What changed for the owner was never the token — it is the MESSAGE beside it.
found_on_the_way.a_hint_that_contained_the_button: `expect(html).not.toContain("Tekrar dene")` failed on a panel that correctly had no button: the hint sentence is "Tekrar denenebilir." The assertion now names the control (`data-panel-retry`), because asserting on words that appear inside other words is how a test passes while the thing it is about is missing.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations of the production source, restored from sha256-verified backups.
mutations: restore `detail=str(exc)` in an alarms route -> the AST guard fails and names the file and line.
put `timeout` in two web buckets -> `test_no_class_is_in_two_web_buckets` fails.
(the catalogue's completeness was proved red by the defect itself: forty classes were missing until the test learned to read the second source).

runtime_proof.why: REAL_PROOF_REQUIRED asks for the ten failed production research runs' messages to be Turkish when reproduced. The mechanism is proven here end to end — every class in the product's taxonomy has a Turkish sentence, no route can answer with an exception, and the web renders each failure kind with its own words and controls — but the production round that replays those ten runs is Karar 0.
